reason: It's free, but Death Note and ORV sitting on a private site means someone ripped them, and I only read through VIZ, Manga Plus, or J-Novel Club — I'm not gonna start reading off stolen files just because the reader is nicer.
objection: I already have Discord plus a shared folder with my friends, so a private site has to beat that AND not make me feel weird about where the files came from — right now it fails the second part.
would_change_my_mind: If you could show me the files are licensed or officially sourced somehow, I'd actually try it — the remembers-where-you-stopped thing sounds useful.
